tagline: The original: steer a snake of squares around a green garden, eat apples to grow, and keep going until the snake fills the whole board.
overview: Snake is the classic arcade game in the colours of an old handheld screen. The snake moves on its own, one square every tenth of a second, and you only choose where it turns. Every apple makes it one square longer and scores ten points, and a longer snake leaves less room to move. The left and right edges of the board wrap around, so you can leave on one side and come back on the other, but the top and bottom are walls. Quick double turns are remembered, so tight U-turns work, and the snake can never reverse straight into itself. A calm ambient tune plays underneath, and your best score is kept between games.
story: Somewhere in a walled garden on a little green screen lives a snake that is always hungry. An apple appears, the snake goes for it, and it grows. Another apple appears somewhere else. The garden never gets bigger, but the snake does, and sooner or later the only thing left in its way is its own tail.
goal: Eat apples and stay alive: hitting the top or bottom wall or biting yourself ends the run. You win by filling the whole board, all 300 squares.
rules: The board is 20 squares wide and 15 high; the snake moves one square every tenth of a second.
Each apple makes the snake one square longer and is worth 10 points; a new apple then appears somewhere else.
The left and right edges wrap around; the top and bottom edges are walls.
Running into a wall or into the snake's own body ends the run.
The snake cannot turn straight back on itself, and two quick turns in a row are both kept, so a U-turn works.
Fill the board (a snake 300 squares long) to win. The best score is saved.

controls.action: Turn the snake (the first one starts the game)
Play again after a game over

characters.name: The snake
characters.description: A row of green squares with a darker head. It never stops moving: all you decide is where it turns. Every apple adds one square to its tail.

characters.name: The apple
characters.description: A red square somewhere in the garden. Eat it for 10 points and one more square of snake; another one appears straight away.

tips: Use the wrap-around: going off the left or right edge is often the fastest way to an apple on the far side.
Keep to the edges and leave the middle of the board open as the snake gets long.
Turn twice quickly to double back along a row: both turns are remembered.

gallery.caption: A new game: press an arrow key to start. The score, the length and the best score are along the top.
The first apple eaten: 10 points, a snake of four, and the next apple already waiting.
Through the edge: the snake leaves the board on the right and comes back on the left.
Paused with P: nothing moves until you press it again.
Game over after hitting the top wall: Space plays again.
